name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Lie on a flat bench and press the barbell up from chest level until arms are fully extended.

name: Barbell Squat
description: Stand with barbell on back, lower by bending knees and hips, then return to standing position.

name: Deadlift
description: Lift barbell from ground to hip level by extending the hips and knees.

name: Pull-ups
description: Hang from bar with arms extended, pull body up until chin is over bar.

name: Overhead Press
description: Press barbell overhead from shoulder level to full arm extension.

name: Barbell Row
description: Bend over and pull barbell to lower chest while keeping back straight.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: Hold dumbbells at sides, curl weights up to shoulders.

name: Tricep Dips
description: Lower body by bending elbows, then push back up to starting position.

name: Leg Press
description: Push platform away using legs while seated in leg press machine.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Pull bar down to chest level while seated, engaging back muscles.

name: Incline Bench Press
description: Press barbell on incline bench to target upper chest.

name: Decline Bench Press
description: Press barbell on decline bench to target lower chest.

name: Leg Curls
description: Curl legs up against resistance while lying face down.

name: Leg Extensions
description: Extend legs against resistance while seated.

name: Calf Raises
description: Raise heels off ground to work calf muscles.

name: Shoulder Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to sides to shoulder level.

name: Front Raise
description: Raise dumbbells in front of body to shoulder level.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Bend over and raise weights out to sides to target rear deltoids.

name: Hammer Curls
description: Curl dumbbells with neutral grip to target biceps and forearms.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Push cable attachment down using triceps.

name: Cable Crossover
description: Pull cables across body to target chest muscles.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
description: Lie on bench and lower dumbbells out to sides with slight bend in elbows.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Lower barbell while keeping legs mostly straight to target hamstrings.

name: Lunges
description: Step forward and lower body by bending both knees.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear foot elevated squat variation for leg development.

name: Plank
description: Hold body in straight line supported by forearms and toes.

name: Crunches
description: Lie on back and lift shoulders off ground using abs.

name: Russian Twists
description: Seated position, rotate torso side to side while holding weight.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
description: Hang from bar and raise legs to work lower abs.

name: Face Pulls
description: Pull cable to face level targeting rear deltoids and upper back.

name: Chest Dips
description: Lean forward during dips to emphasize chest muscles.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Pull T-bar to chest while bent over to work back muscles.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Pull cable to torso while seated to target middle back.

name: Shrugs
description: Raise shoulders up toward ears to work traps.

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotating shoulder press variation named after Arnold Schwarzenegger.

name: Preacher Curls
description: Bicep curls performed on preacher bench for isolation.

name: Concentration Curls
description: Single-arm bicep curl performed while seated.

name: Skull Crushers
description: Lie on bench and lower barbell to forehead then extend arms.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
description: Hold weight overhead and lower behind head using triceps.

name: Hip Thrusts
description: Thrust hips upward while upper back is on bench.

name: Goblet Squat
description: Squat while holding dumbbell or kettlebell at chest level.

name: Hack Squat
description: Squat variation performed on hack squat machine.

name: Good Mornings
description: Bend forward at hips with barbell on back to target hamstrings and lower back.

name: Box Jumps
description: Jump onto elevated platform and step down.

name: Farmers Walk
description: Walk while carrying heavy weights in each hand.

name: Bicycle Crunches
description: Alternating elbow to opposite knee crunch motion.

name: Mountain Climbers
description: In plank position, alternate bringing knees to chest quickly.

name: Burpees
description: Full body exercise combining squat, plank, and jump.

name: Battle Ropes
description: Create waves with heavy ropes for cardio and upper body workout.

name: Kettlebell Swings
description: Swing kettlebell between legs and up to chest level using hip drive.
